title: Application FileSharing Syncthing Entity
description: Syncthing-specific configuration. Extends Application/FileSharing with Syncthing-specific settings.

gui_password_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for the web GUI password.

path.description: Local filesystem path for the folder.

devices.description: Device IDs to share this folder with.

default_folder_path.description: Default path for new shared folders.

global_announce_enabled.description: Whether global discovery announcement is enabled.

local_announce_enabled.description: Whether local discovery announcement is enabled.
